summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter feature, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack-based walk, indent 4 per level, traced to Measurement(11, 19) for the acceptance tree). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (measured max, or min of measured max and explicit width), and a new public VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in render options in print(). CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased and adds an Added section with two entries. tests/test_align.py adds VerticalCenter import, repr, render (padded and tall content), and measure tests. tests/test_tree.py adds Measurement import and a measurement test for the acceptance tree. Choices: extra tall-content test added; Tree test uses console width via Measurement.get with no max width. Tests were not run; all verification was by reading the code.
